meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络模型，模拟基因敲除与通量分布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做代谢网络建模或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network models, simulate gene knockouts and flux distributions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on constraint-based metabolic modeling or metabolic engineering analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能加载、编辑和运行代谢模型，进行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等计算，并输出结果。
howto.when: 当你要求分析代谢模型、预测生长速率、模拟基因敲除或优化培养基时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型并运行FBA。
say.note: Claude会加载模型并计算生长速率。

say.text: 对iJO1366模型做单基因敲除筛选。
say.note: Claude会执行敲除分析并返回必需基因列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load, edit, and run metabolic models, perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout simulations, flux sampling, and output results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze metabolic models, predict growth rates, simulate gene knockouts, or optimize growth media.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run FBA.
say_en.note: Claude loads the model and computes growth rate.

say_en.text: Perform single gene deletion on iJO1366.
say_en.note: Claude runs knockout analysis and returns essential genes.
